additions.name: DATA4 Madrid MAD01 — existing Alcobendas campus operations

status.summary: In an interview published November 13, 2026, DATA4 Spain’s managing director described the Alcobendas campus as operating at near-full occupancy.

locator.method: CartoCiudad address register point for Avenida Industria 15, Alcobendas.
locator.precision: Public campus address point. Individual data halls have no separate mapped position.
locator.identity_review: The operator identifies MAD01 at this street address. CartoCiudad and Catastro match the address and the same cadastral parcel.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The register provides no quantitative positional accuracy for this address point.

additions.distinctness_review: The nearest prior site is Equinix MD2, about 254 metres away at Calle Valgrande 6 on a different cadastral parcel. Goodman MAD01 is a different operator and property. Other DATA4 sites in the prior inventory are outside Spain.
additions.successor_review: The original interview confirms present campus operation and discusses possible future expansions. No subsequent change of lifecycle status was identified through November 26.

additions.name: Datacenter United Oostkamp — cooling and efficiency upgrades

status.summary: In its interim report approved on November 23, Corilis reported that Datacenter United had completed the cooling and efficiency upgrades at Oostkamp.

locator.method: Use the Flemish address-register point for Brugsestraat 196 bus 1, 8020 Oostkamp.
locator.precision: Registered business-unit address on the commercial property.
locator.identity_review: The operator names Brugsestraat 196/1 in Oostkamp and prints the postal code as 8200. The Belgian enterprise register and the Flemish address register agree on the street, number, unit, municipality and official postcode 8020. The address represents the facility property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The address register supplies no numeric horizontal error for this point or location for the upgraded equipment.

additions.distinctness_review: The new record covers improvements to Datacenter United’s existing Oostkamp / Bruges property in West Flanders. The four Belgian sites in snapshot 193 are in the Brussels area. Equinix BX1 is in Bruges in the Bordeaux metropolitan area of France. The geographically nearest listed site is ETIX Lille #1 in Tourcoing, France.
additions.successor_review: The November report confirms the completed cooling and efficiency work already disclosed on September 23. Further facility investments described on the operator’s undated page have a broader scope.
